title: Email Change Guard
description: Stops people locking themselves out by changing their account email to a typo: it catches misspelled providers (gmial.con) with a one-tap fix, shows exactly where the confirmation stops matching, spots the same inbox (Gmail dots, +tags), says what moves with the address (sign-in, receipts, 2FA codes), and keeps the old address active until the new one is verified, with resend, edit and cancel while it waits.
stops: Locked out by a typo'd new email
